title: The problem with integer programming
authors: H. P. Williams
read_depth: Core sections; working-paper PDF pages 21-23
abstract_summary: Surveys structural obstacles to integer programming and alternative mathematical representations.
method_summary: Uses integer monoids and nested-rounding Chvátal functions including directed-tree representations.
contribution_summary: Explicitly states shift periodicity and illustrates affine average gradient of a nested rounding tree.
overlap_with_roundguard: Direct prior art for affine drift plus periodic rounding residuals.
difference_or_limit: Does not give the proposed mixed-mode bounded-grid invoice analyzer. Working paper is 2010; journal issue is 2011; DOI imaman not inaman.

title: Discrete subadditive functions as Gomory functions
authors: Frank Rhodes; H. Paul Williams
venue: Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society
read_depth: Publisher extract and metadata; not full proof
abstract_summary: Studies when discrete subadditive functions belong to a class arising in pure integer programming.
method_summary: Uses pure integer programming proof methods motivated by discrete metrics.
contribution_summary: Characterizes a class of Gomory functions and connects it to discrete subadditivity.
overlap_with_roundguard: Older foundation referenced by Williams for Chvátal simplification and discrete functions.
difference_or_limit: Full proof not inspected; no specific periodicity theorem attributed to this paper. Print issue year 1995 despite later online digitization.

title: Mixed-Integer Linear Representability, Disjunctions, and Chvátal Functions—Modeling Implications
authors: Amitabh Basu; Kipp Martin; Christopher Thomas Ryan; Guanyi Wang
read_depth: Core Definition 2.2 and Section 3 elimination proofs
abstract_summary: Characterizes mixed-integer representable sets through affine Chvátal inequalities.

overlap_with_roundguard: Strong syntactic overlap with affine rounding trees and exact Presburger encodings.
difference_or_limit: Positive scaling and ceiling fragment; does not state the specific invoice finite-state optimization.

title: isl: An Integer Set Library for the Polyhedral Model
authors: Sven Verdoolaege
read_depth: Publisher paper abstract; official manual core Section 1.4.13 (manual is not the conference paper)
abstract_summary: Presents a library for exact manipulation of integer sets and relations bounded by affine constraints.
method_summary: Arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic, integer-set operations, and quasi-affine expressions with constant integer division.
contribution_summary: Reusable infrastructure for exact polyhedral and Presburger-style analysis.
overlap_with_roundguard: Exact integer encoding of fixed-quantum rational affine rounding is within this framework.
difference_or_limit: General library; not a monetary-policy tool or a claim of minimal residue periods.

title: Presburger arithmetic, rational generating functions, and quasi-polynomials
authors: Kevin Woods
read_depth: Abstract and foundational definitions
abstract_summary: Connects Presburger-definable sets and counting functions to rational generating functions and piecewise quasi-polynomials.
method_summary: Logical and geometric characterizations of integer sets using linear inequalities and quantifiers.
contribution_summary: Provides equivalent representations and discusses their complexity.
overlap_with_roundguard: Establishes mature exact integer framework adjacent to rounding residue structure.
difference_or_limit: Counting theorem is not itself the proposed equality or discrepancy algorithm.

title: Catala: a programming language for the law

contribution_summary: Evaluates US tax and French benefit encodings and reports an official implementation bug.
overlap_with_roundguard: Prior application of formal methods to taxes and benefits.

title: Formalizing Date Arithmetic and Statically Detecting Ambiguities for the Law
authors: Raphaël Monat; Aymeric Fromherz; Denis Merigoux

overlap_with_roundguard: Direct prior art for rounding-policy sensitivity verification in computational law.

title: CUTECat: Concolic Execution for Computational Law
authors: Pierre Goutagny; Aymeric Fromherz; Raphaël Monat

title: Combinatorics and Algorithms on Low-Discrepancy Roundings of a Real Sequence

title: Interactive Proofs for Rounding Arithmetic
authors: Shuo Chen; Jung Hee Cheon; Dongwoo Kim; Daejun Park

title: Coding computational laws: 20 recommendations for public administrations

overlap_with_roundguard: Explicitly discusses arbitrary-precision monetary numbers and rounding risks.

overlap_with_roundguard: Current 2026 prior art confirms min/max-plus convolution is a mature primitive.

overlap_with_roundguard: Direct adjacent financial-total rounding optimization prior art.

title: Probabilistic Floating-Point Round-Off Analysis via Concentration Inequalities

overlap_with_roundguard: Current 2026 numerical-analysis neighbor checked for the search cutoff.

title: Automatically Improving Accuracy for Floating Point Expressions

title: Robustness Analysis of Finite Precision Implementations

overlap_with_roundguard: Prior relational reasoning between two arithmetic semantics, including branch instability.

title: Scallop: A Language for Neurosymbolic Programming

contribution_summary: A reusable mechanized library for proving properties of floating-point algorithms.
overlap_with_roundguard: Formal rounding semantics and tie behavior are established foundations.

authors: Laura Titolo; Mariano Moscato; Marco A. Feliu; Paolo Masci; César A. Muñoz
